errors.evidence: The figure shows four indicators per time period, not three. The machine-generated description omits one indicator.
The description omits the exact values for Welthandel (5.4%, 4.8%, 2.3%) and Exporte Deutschland (5.3%, 5.0%, 0.4%) for all three decades, which are explicitly mentioned in the reference.

The description does not explicitly state the color mapping for all four categories as done in the reference (e.g., dark green for Welt-BIP, light green for Welthandel, dark blue for Exporte Deutschland, light blue for Industrieproduktion Deutschland).
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates the *average percentage values* of the indicators, as highlighted in the reference ("prozentualen Durchschnittswerte").
